symbols.name: output coordinate count
symbols.meaning: The number of coordinates of each output vector of the linear map $L$.
symbols.quote: Let $L\colon \mathbb{C}^m \to \mathbb{C}^{m'}$ be a linear map, where $m$ is the number of coordinates of its input vectors and $m'$ is the number of coordinates of its output vectors.

symbols.name: operator norm
symbols.meaning: The largest value of $\|Lx\|$ over all vectors $x$ with $\|x\| \le 1$.
symbols.quote: Its operator norm $\|L\|$ is defined through the [supremum](supremum.md) of $\|Lx\|$ over all $x$ with $\|x\| \le 1$.

symbols.name: error vector
symbols.meaning: The difference between the computed input and the exact input $x$, so that the computed input is $x + \eta$.
symbols.quote: Suppose the computed input is $x + \eta$ where $x$ is the exact input and $\eta$ is the error vector.

relations.predicate: acts on the vector spaces of
relations.quote: A linear contraction is a linear map that acts on the vector spaces of [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md) and never increases the maximum modulus of a vector.
Its operator norm $\|L\|$ is defined through the [supremum](supremum.md) of $\|Lx\|$ over all $x$ with $\|x\| \le 1$.
